snippet.title: Esoteric Ebb | Release Window Reveal
snippet.description:
Fantasy CRPG, Esoteric Ebb, will launch in Spring 2026!

Developed by Christoffer Bodegård, Esoteric Ebb is an isometric, TTRPG-turned-CRPG, featuring deep, comedic and branching dialogue with a staggering amount of choice set in an Arcanepunk-fantasy setting. Solve the mystery of an exploded tea shop, become The Cleric of legends... or completely ruin the campaign. 

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2057760/Esoteric_Ebb/
